title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Siddhu The Warrior
desc: A rich man does everything he can to restore his mother's failing health. However, finding no success, he follows the advice of a sage who tells him to turn into a beggar for 48 hours.

title: Badla Naag Ka 3
desc: A shape-shifting snake-woman in search of her lover whom she lost two decades ago, sets out to win his love again.

title: Benki
desc: When antisocial elements in a humble village community harass a young woman, her protective brother embarks on a path of vengeance.

title: Mumbai Ki Kiran Bedi
desc: When an IPS officer is killed by a criminal gang, her father meets her lookalike. He then decides to train her to be just like his daughter in order to avenge her death.

title: Aho Vikramaarka
desc: A ruthless cop unearths a sinister mystery, compelling him to confront the villainous Asura and rescue the victims held captive in his clutches.
